name: Card opens the page
note: A real card grows into the next page

name: Button opens the page
note: My Calendar opens through the button's own shape

name: Deck swap
note: One page slides under as the next deals on top

name: Feature tag
note: The control's outline becomes the feature name below

name: Chapter mark
note: The nav row grows into the chapter title and flies back

name: Question hook
note: A real question typed into the real Ask field

name: Stat line
note: A true number counts in and lands on the page

name: Spotlight
note: The page dims, one thing stays lit

name: Drawn mark
note: A hand-drawn circle, underline and arrow

name: Loupe
note: A magnifier reads the small text

name: Press mark
note: The press, then a line to where it landed

name: List re-rank
note: Sort by Newest and the cards really move

name: Blocks land
note: The button flies down and becomes its calendar block

name: Tally roll
note: Each event lands, then the count rolls
